facts.subject: «Leyli və Məcnun» (Üzeyir Hacıbəyov) — the first opera of the Muslim East. Premiere 12 January 1908 old style = 25 January new style (en.wikipedia Leyli and Majnun (opera) gives both; azertag + azer.com + Wikipedia Hajibeyov say '12 January 1908') at Tağıyev's theatre in Baku (all 4). Hacıbəyov born 18 Sep 1885 → 22 at the premiere (Wikipedia Hajibeyov 'at 22, in 1908'; azertag 'He was 22'); azer.com says 23 → wrong, ignore. 'First opera of the Muslim East / Islamic world' (Wikipedia ×3 pages, azertag, azer.com). Libretto from Füzuli's poem, many verses kept unchanged (Wikipedia + azertag). Majnun = Hüseynqulu Sarabski (Wikipedia ×2, azertag cast). Leyli sung by a MAN because women were not allowed on stage (azertag 'All the parts were played by men'; azer.com: religious authorities, women could not appear; Wikipedia cast lists a male singer, name spelled Abdurrahman/Abdurrahim/Abdulrahim Farajev → name NOT used). Single-source, NOT on cards: 2 000+ performances (Wikipedia only); tea-house waiter legend (azer.com, 'as the story goes'); Sarabski ~400 times as Majnun (Wikipedia Sarabski only). Premiere date: use '1908-ci ilin yanvarında' / '12 (25) yanvar 1908' to avoid calendar confusion.

facts.subject: Goitered gazelle (ceyran) in Azerbaijan: 'In the early 20th century up to 60,000 gazelles grazed in the plains of Azerbaijan' (IUCN 2017 only — WWF says 'tens of thousands' → voice says 'on minlərlə', the 60 000 only with 'IUCN-a görə' on screen). Low point: 'less than 200' in a 1961 aerial count (IUCN) / '200 specimens in the 1960s (Safarov, 1961)' (WWF) → '1961-ci ildə 200-dən az'. Shirvan State Reserve founded 1969 (Wikipedia Shirvan NP), National Park 5 Jul 2003, ~54 000 ha (Wikipedia 54 373,5 ha + WWF '54,000 h'). Recovery: Shirvan 'some 6,000 animals' (WWF) / '2,000 to 6,000' (IUCN 2017) → 'Şirvanda sayı 6 000-ə çatdı' (dated sources: say 'çatdı', not 'bu gün'). 200 → 6 000 = 30× (our arithmetic). Reintroduction from 2010 to Abşeron, Qobustan, Ağgöl, Acınohur etc. (WWF, IDEA, Wikipedia) — counts differ (≈150 vs 443) → no count. 'The 6 000 started from only 77 animals' = WWF only → NOT used unless the 20:45 build finds a 2nd source. Red Book of Azerbaijan (IDEA). Body 24–33 kg, horns 27–41 cm (IDEA only, not in voice).
